title: Zenith Light Saudi Arabian Chicken Kebabs
description: A nutty and light Saudi Arabian dish featuring chicken stock concentrate, yakimono-grill, and gluten-free-friendly ingredients, perfect for a cozy dinner. This recipe is easy to make and serves 4 people.
instructions: Preheat the yakimono-grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together chicken stock concentrate, olive oil, lemon juice, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated chicken pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the chicken kebabs for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until cooked through.
Sprinkle the chopped almonds and parsley over the kebabs during the last minute of grilling.
Serve the kebabs hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
Let the kebabs rest for a few minutes before serving.
Serve with your favorite sides, such as rice or roasted vegetables.
